data.name: Mahjongg Investigations: Under Suspicion
data.detailed_description:
O crime organizado está a tomar conta de Metro City. Como detetive do 83º Recinto, tens de usar as tuas habilidades no jogo de Mahjongg para desenterrar pistas e levar os criminosos à justiça. Don Diamante, o padrinho sem rival da cidade tem de ser localizado e capturado. Recolhe e junta as peças com provas para apanhar os culpados. Peças com pistas especiais revelam informações ocultas e mini-jogos no percurso permitem-te interrogar, analisar e fechar o caso! Faz a tua carreira tornando as ruas mais seguras para o bem-estar de todos os habitantes de Metro City.
  • Progride através de 10 níveis no 83º recinto. Tens as capacidades para te tornares em Vice-Comissário?
  • Crimes cada vez mais complexos, com criminosos desafiantes e níveis de jogo cada vez mais difíceis.
  • Vários mini-jogos, podes interrogar, fazer análises de ADN e muito mais!
  • Encontra 5 peças especiais que podem revelar pistas vitais quando combinadas entre elas.
  • Vasta paisagem urbana, com mais de 20 locais para explorar.
  • Capacidade ilimitada de repetição do jogo com reprodução avançada do cenário, sempre diferente cada vez que jogas.

reviews.review:
Mahjongg Investigations: Under Suspicion takes the familiar concept of Mahjong solitaire and transforms it into a detective adventure that gives every puzzle a greater sense of purpose. Developed by Zemnott and published by Ziggurat, the game casts players as an investigator assigned to the 83rd Precinct in Metro City, where organized crime has become deeply rooted. Instead of merely clearing tile layouts for the sake of progression, every successful puzzle contributes to uncovering evidence, exposing criminals, and gradually dismantling the operations of the city's powerful underworld leader, Don Diamante. This combination of classic puzzle mechanics and crime-solving creates a more engaging experience than a traditional Mahjong title, offering players a reason to stay invested beyond simply completing boards.

The gameplay remains grounded in the well-established rules of Mahjong solitaire, requiring players to locate and remove matching free tiles until each layout has been cleared. What separates the game from countless similar releases is the way investigations are woven directly into the gameplay. Certain tiles represent clues that help identify suspects, advance ongoing cases, and unlock new leads. As players continue solving puzzles, they climb through ten detective ranks, earning promotions while tackling increasingly difficult investigations. The gradual increase in challenge ensures that new board layouts and more elaborate cases continue to test observation skills without abandoning the relaxing nature that makes Mahjong games appealing.

The detective theme extends beyond the puzzle boards through a collection of investigative mini-games that reinforce the overall atmosphere. Players question suspects, examine DNA evidence, and participate in various police activities that provide welcome variety between Mahjong sessions. These features are not especially complex, but they successfully prevent the experience from becoming repetitive and help strengthen the illusion of working through actual criminal investigations. Additional clue tile mechanics encourage players to think beyond simple tile matching, adding small strategic considerations that make every completed board feel more rewarding.

Visually, the game reflects its era but still delivers a convincing detective atmosphere. More than twenty different locations help establish the setting of Metro City, with crime scenes, police environments, and suspect encounters supporting the investigative storyline. Character artwork and interface design emphasize the noir-inspired presentation, even if the graphics naturally show their age compared to more recent puzzle games. The straightforward menus and intuitive controls make the experience easy to learn, allowing both newcomers and longtime Mahjong players to jump into solving cases without unnecessary complexity.

Replay value is supported through randomized crime scenarios that encourage multiple playthroughs rather than presenting a completely fixed sequence of events. While the fundamental Mahjong gameplay remains familiar throughout, changing investigations and increasingly challenging layouts help maintain player interest over time. The detective progression, evidence gathering, and variety of supporting activities give the game a stronger sense of momentum than many puzzle titles that rely solely on clearing one board after another.

Mahjongg Investigations: Under Suspicion succeeds by adding meaningful context to a timeless puzzle formula. The detective narrative, career progression, investigative mini-games, and evidence collection mechanics work together to create an experience that feels more substantial than standard Mahjong solitaire while remaining accessible to casual players. Although its presentation reflects the technology of its original release, the gameplay remains enjoyable thanks to its thoughtful integration of mystery elements and satisfying progression system. Players looking for a relaxing puzzle game with a narrative twist will find plenty to appreciate in this creative combination of crime solving and classic tile matching.

Rating: 7/10
